title: Binance Futures Updates Taker Program (2025-08-12)
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, As Binance conducts regular reviews of its programs to provide users with the most value and competitive services, Binance will be updating its  USDⓢ-M Futures Taker Program  effective from  2025-08-12 07:00 (UTC) . Key Highlights: Significantly lowered entry thresholds across all tiers, enabling more active traders to reach the top tier. Tier 1: Requirement reduced from 0.2% to 0.05%, making fee discounts accessible to a broader range of takers. Tier 2: Lowered from 0.4% to 0.2%. Tier 3: Lowered from 1.2% to 1%. The new Taker Fee Discounts will take effect starting from approximately  2025-08-12 07:00 (UTC)  and will be updated weekly based on user eligibility. The first evaluation will be based on trading performance from 2025-08-04 00:00 (UTC) to 2025-08-10 23:59 (UTC). Until the new discounts are applied, users will continue to enjoy their current Taker Fee Discount. The new Binance Futures USDⓢ-M Taker Program is as follows: Fee Tier Program Qualification Criteria Taker Fee Discount on USDT-M and USDC-M Perpetual and Delivery Contracts Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share on BTC, ETH, and BNB Pairs Or Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share (Excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB Pairs) 1 0.05% ≤ X < 0.2% Or 0.05% ≤ X < 0.2% 10% 2 0.2% ≤ X < 1% Or 0.2% ≤ X < 1% 14% 3 X ≥ 1% Or X ≥ 1% 18% How to Participate: Users who reach a  total Binance Futures trading volume of 100,000,000 USDT equivalent  in the last 30 days may   submit the  application form  for the Taker Program at any time, and be assessed for eligibility in the Program’s weekly rev iew. The Taker Fee Discount will be effective from the following Tuesday at approximately 07:00 (UTC) after the weekly review.   For more information and further inquiries, please email  futures-business@binance.com  or contact your sales and key account coverage teams directly. Apply Now Terms & Conditions: Binance Futures Taker Program will be reviewed on a weekly basis (Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC). The taker discount in the Futures Taker Program will also apply to TradFi Perps. Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs is defined by the user's weekly Taker Transaction Volume on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs divided by the weekly total Taker Transaction Volume on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs in the USDⓈ-M market. Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs is defined by the user's weekly Taker Transaction Volume excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs divided by the weekly total Taker Transaction Volume excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs in the USDⓈ-M market. The Taker Fee Discount will be directly applied to each Taker trade. All Taker Program participants’ eligibility to receive Taker Fee Discount is reviewed and adjusted once a week based on the previous week's performance on all qualified pairs. Any fee tier adjustments will be updated on each Tuesday at approximately 07:00 (UTC) based on the aforementioned criteria. The Taker Fee Discounts are applied  on top of  the  BNB fee discount and VIP tier rates. Binance Futures will provide daily and weekly reports to participating users via email. Users will be removed from the Taker Program if they do not meet the minimum criteria for  three consecutive weeks , and can reapply for the Taker Program after 3 months upon removal. All trading volumes and metrics related to the Promotion are measured by Binance at its sole and absolute discretion. Self trades will be excluded from volume calculations. Binance reserves the right to amend or terminate this Program at its sole discretion. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-07-31 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2026-02-04 to clarify that the taker discount in the USDⓢ-M Futures Taker Program will also apply to TradFi Perps. This announcement was updated on 2026-02-03 to clarify that the taker discount in the USDⓢ-M Futures Taker Program will not apply to TradFi Perps.
